prior_coverage: Heavily swept before; most of it stands. licensing-ip (5-6.9.2026): scouts research/colony-sweep/scouts/licensing-ip--3d-print-on-demand.md, --stock-media.md, --fonts-icons.md; audit research/colony-sweep/audits/licensing-ip.md; verdict docs/REJECTED.md:984-1023 (group at ₪0; the price floor is zero for what we can make: generic stock, icons, consumer STL, REJECTED.md:997; itch.io, Freepik and Creative Fabrica pay 'fractions of a shekel', :1002; Cults3D createCreation takes a writable madeWithAi, :998-1000). storefronts (3.9): scouts storefronts--game-3d-assets.md (itch.io, Unity, Fab, Roblox) and storefronts--asset-marketplaces.md (Envato, Creative Market, TemplateMonster); groups/storefronts.md:162,185 (Fab gated on Hyperwallet Israel; Unreal Marketplace folded into Fab); Unity refuted to ₪0 at REJECTED.md:663-668. CHIEF-AUDIT.md:47 lists Getty/Alamy/Creative Fabrica/Canva as missed. CHIEF-AUDIT.md:302 drops Fab and Cults3D owner steps because the lines were rejected. Standing DEAD, no new evidence against them: Adobe Stock (REJECTED.md:1006-1012: no contributor upload API, CSV has no AI column, portal login with CAPTCHA). Hebrew fonts (REJECTED.md:995; fonts-icons scout §3: an OFL derivative 'may not be sold by itself'; §7: a saleable Hebrew family cannot be made by software in the time available). MyMiniFactory plus Thingiverse, anti-AI (REJECTED.md:1020-1022; github-secondary tyschacht/nanoclaw_passive content/research/ai-3d-model-cults3d.md, dated 2026-05-02: the 'SoulCrafted' policy demands proof of human origin such as WIP files or sculpting videos). Printables (3d-print-on-demand scout §3: no publishing mutation; nanoclaw doc: no upload API, Prusameters are not cash). MakerWorld (scout §2: a photo of a physically printed object on every upload, which means a camera and physical work). TurboSquid, Shutterstock, Pond5, Getty/iStock, Alamy, Depositphotos all ban GenAI supply (scout §5; github ibank31/stockforge-ai docs/MARKETPLACE_UPLOAD_READINESS_STANDARD.md, 24.8.2026). Envato bans AI as the main component and adds 6 months of item support (asset-marketplaces scout §1). Iconfinder closed 15.11.2025 (REJECTED.md:1013-1015). Etsy fails the camera gate: Persona asks for a selfie (KYC catalogue C5; REJECTED.md:274,1209-1217). Creative Market is not ranked: shop application, Tipalti Israel row unread, no API found (asset-marketplaces §3). NEW this sweep: (a) itch.io now has a mandatory Generative AI Disclosure field (snippet), which resolves the AMBER in game-3d-assets.md F2 that stopped the AI-asset-pack variant. (b) Fab requires a 'Created with AI' flag, Sketchfab has required CreatedWithAI since 11.12.2025, and CGTrader allows AI with a 60% new-seller rate (github-secondary: dscherm/comfyprompts docs/research/selling-ai-assets-followup.md, 29.6.2026). (c) Cults3D confirms its default-on 'No AI' filter plus a daily upload cap (snippet, 28.9). (d) A third-party source says Hyperwallet lists Israel (snippet only). (e) A Tranco popularity proxy (github: alexbara2000/BBAT crawler/lists/tranco_10k.csv and tranco_20k.csv) ranks freepik 621, itch.io 2,252, sketchfab 2,746, dreamstime 3,696, creativefabrica 5,918, cults3d 12,075, fab.com 14,973, cgtrader 16,941. (f) Contradiction: the nanoclaw doc says Cults3D has 'no headless upload API'. Five repos, including a live-schema contract test (fredonia88/destl tests_integration.py), show the createCreation mutation exists. No repo shows a successful live create. Cross-cutting risks not settled by anyone: (1) EU marketplaces (Cults3D FR, Freepik ES, Creative Fabrica NL, CGTrader LT) may have to show a trader's name and address to buyers under the DSA, which could publish the owner's name (analogue: Envato does this, asset-marketplaces scout §1). (2) PayPal is not among the seven encoded owner steps (src/revenue/owner-steps.ts:71-78), so every venue here is an eighth-plus owner step under the ACCOUNT CAP (research/channel-loop/BOARD-LOOP.md:17). Packs built for any venue can also be listed on Gumroad (owner step 3) at no extra owner step, but that adds listings, not buyers: Gumroad Discover needs a prior sale (REJECTED.md:640-647). Not examined: Thangs (if its payout is Stripe Connect, an Israeli cannot onboard), IconScout, Superhive/Blender Market, 123RF, Vecteezy, Canva Creators (the inverse model: pays for human-made content).

The 28.9 breadth directive (MISSION.md:358-381) makes many small sales the target shape, but it is not new evidence against the floor. gate_zero_cost.evidence: Free to publish. The seller sets itch's cut from 0% to 100% (default 10%), and payment processing of about 2.9% + $0.30 comes out of the sale. Source: research/colony-sweep/scouts/storefronts--game-3d-assets.md:47-52, snippet-grade in the repo.

gate_programmatic_listing.evidence: butler (github itchio/butler cmd/push/push.go) uploads files to an existing target 'username/game'. docs/pushing.md says tags can be changed later 'from the Edit game page'. Undisclosed AI makes an asset ineligible for indexing. Sources: Engadget, itch.io/t/4309690, 80.lv, all snippets. Whether AI-tagged assets are down-ranked or filtered by default: UNKNOWN (thread itch.io/t/4527500 complains that itch 'decided to hide' which assets are AI, i.e. no default filter, snippet title only).
